entities.summary: Eric Williams, a notable figure in the history of Trinidad and Tobago, associated with Oil Discovery, Labour Movement, and Independence (1950–1962). Preceded by People's National Movement and West Indies Federation. Their legacy influenced Independence of Trinidad and Tobago — August 31, 1962 and Eric Williams founds the PNM 1956.
